He describes what life was really like inside, the gang wars, alliances, weapons, drugs and constant threat of violence.

In 1991, US authorities estimated that members of the Aryan Brotherhood prison gang had been responsible for 18 percent of murders among inmates and more than 40 percent of murders of prison staff since the gang’s founding in the late 1960s. At the same time, the gang comprised less than 0.1 percent of the inmate population, making the Brotherhood the deadliest prison gang by percentage.
